title: Rep Failure Haptic Duel
oneLiner: Two lifters race to maintain clean form while watch haptics and a shared phone screen turn muscle-failure estimates into a short, replayable duel.
targetUser: Gym partners using Apple Watch who want a playful set without filming themselves.
keyUX: Pair watches, calibrate, run a 45-second dual set, show clean reps and fatigue estimates, then share a safe recap.
